title: Pullman's garden lodge gets its second roof
items: The lodge across 18th Street from the Pullman house now has its front in two parts, as the 1894 Inland plate and Lowe's print of about 1897 both show it. The west part stands forward with a quoined corner under a hipped roof of its own, just below the main roof's crested deck, and the loggia and balcony sit back beside it.
